writtenTo: Titus, leading the churches on Crete
importantNotes: 'The grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation for all people' (2:11) — a summary of the gospel.
'He saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy' (3:5).
Titus is a practical handbook for church health — doctrine shapes behavior.
Paul quotes a Cretan philosopher (1:12) — 'Cretans are always liars' — to make his point.
The letter shows that Christian faith should transform everyday life, not just Sunday worship.

chapters.1: Appoint qualified elders on Crete; rebuke false teachers who must be silenced.
chapters.2: Sound doctrine for every age group — older men, older women, young men, slaves; grace teaches us.
chapters.3: Be subject to authorities; saved by mercy through the washing of renewal; avoid foolish controversies.
